column6: The Delian League formed after the Persian Wars grew into the Athenian empire that Sparta fought.
Alexander's conquest of Persia was framed as revenge for Xerxes' invasion; the wars set up the Greek-Persian relationship.
Byzantine Christianity starts from Constantine, Nicaea and the Theodosian settlement.
Papal and episcopal authority grew out of the late Roman church.
The conquest of Mexico cannot be understood without the tribute empire and its resentful subject peoples.
Pizarro's conquest depended on the Inca civil war and epidemic.
Early modern European trade entered an existing Indian Ocean network.
Portuguese voyages aimed at, and disrupted, Indian Ocean trade.
Babur founded the Mughal Empire by defeating the last Delhi sultan at Panipat (1526).
The Revolution arose from colonial self-government and the post-1763 tightening of British control.
The Congress of Vienna was the settlement of the Napoleonic Wars.
Resistance to Napoleonic rule and his redrawing of German and Italian borders fed nineteenth-century nationalism.
The civil rights movement relied on the Fourteenth and Fifteenth Amendments and fought the Jim Crow order that followed Reconstruction.
Japanese expansion in the 1930s grew from the Meiji state's industrial and imperial project.
The New Deal response built on Progressive-era ideas of federal regulation.
Tsarist autocracy and serfdom, built from Peter to Catherine, are the background to 1917.
